Bill.BriefDescription: Imposing a state tax on bottled water to fund public health services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to imposing a state tax on bottled water to fundpublic health services; and adding a new chapter to Title 82 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Bottle" means any closed container which is labeled by amanufacturer of bottled water and used to contain or convey bottledwater. (2) "Bottled water" means all water which is sealed in bottlesoffered for sale for human consumption. (3) "Department" means the state department of revenue. (4) "Manufacturer" means any processor, bottler, or other personwho fills or refills a bottle with bottled water and others engaged inpurifying, filtrating, or any other alteration of water for the purposeof selling or reselling bottled water. (5) "Person" has the same meaning as provided in RCW 82.04.030. (6) "Purchaser" means any person who purchases in a retail sale. (7) "Retail sale" means any sale to a person for use orconsumption, and not for resale. p. 1 HB 3120 (8) "Retailer" means any person who engages in the business of theretail sale of bottled water in the state. (9) "Sale" or "purchase" has the same meaning as "sale" as providedin RCW 82.04.050. (10) "Wholesaler" means any person who engages in the business ofselling or supplying bottled water to any person for resale in thestate.
A tax is imposed on each wholesale sale ofbottled water within the state. The rate of tax is 0.00296 dollars perounce.
Liability for payment of the tax imposedunder this chapter is to be borne by the wholesaler.

(1) The wholesaler must remit the tax andfile returns in accordance with section 5 of this act. (2) If any retailer located in the state receives or otherwiseobtains bottled water upon which the tax imposed under this chapter hasnot been collected by any wholesaler, then the retailer shall remit thetax directly to the department in accordance with section 5 of thisact.

Chapter 82.32 RCW applies to the tax imposedin this chapter. The tax due dates, reporting periods, and returnrequirements applicable to chapter 82.04 RCW apply equally to the taximposed in this chapter. The department must adopt rules to implementthis chapter.

All tax proceeds collected under thischapter must be deposited in the public health services account createdin RCW 43.72.902 for the purpose of funding local health jurisdictionsto conduct core public health functions of statewide significance, asdefined in RCW 43.70.514.
Sections 1 through 6 of this act constitute HB 3120 p. 2 a new chapter in Title 82 RCW.
